questions.question: Explain the difference between innate and adaptive immunity.
questions.solution_html:
• Innate immunity is the body's immediate, non-specific defence against pathogens, while
  • adaptive immunity is a more specialized and long-lasting response that develops after
  • exposure to a specific pathogen. Innate Immunity does not target a specific type of pathogen
  • but responds to a broad range of invaders. It is present at birth providing a rapid response. It
  • includes skin, mucous membranes and phagocytes
  • Adaptive Immunity recognizes and targets specific pathogens. It develops over time as the
  • body is exposed to pathogens or vaccines. It involves B cells (which produce antibodies)
  • and T cells (which directly attack infected cells).

questions.question: What are preventive measures for maintaining a healthy respiratory system?
questions.solution_html:
• For maintaining a healthy respiratory system, prioritize preventing infections, avoiding
  • harmful exposures, and adopting a healthy lifestyle.

  • Avoiding Second hand Smoke: Exposure to second hand smoke is harmful and has to be
  • avoided.
  • Minimizing Air Pollution Exposure: Limiting the time outdoors during periods of high
  • air pollution and consider wearing a mask if necessary.
  • Improving indoor Air Quality: Ventilate the home regularly and use air purifiers.

  • Regular exercise: Physical activity strengthens the lungs and improves overall
  • respiratory function.

  • muscles and improve lung capacity.

  • provides essential nutrients for respiratory health.
